brandSources.note: Used the portfolio's exact #ffd235 gold as the signature accent. The site's text is #333333 and its canvas is predominantly white.

The portfolio uses a light canvas, but its exact gold does not meet the graph's accent contrast requirement on white. The dark warm ink background keeps the gold recognizable and legible; this is an intentional contrast adaptation, not a claim that the source site is dark.

brandSources.from: Chosen from compatible cool and warm tones around the portfolio gold; checked by the StoryTeller build
brandSources.note: The five clusters use distinct restrained hues to separate career direction, operations, team growth, product design, and leadership.

brandSources.from: System font stacks; the portfolio's Atkinson Hyperlegible face is proprietary to its Webflow assets
brandSources.note: Used Arial, Segoe UI, and system fallbacks without a remote font request. No logo is embedded.
